complexity.notes: best_buy is dead code: it is updated each outer iteration but the inner loop uses prices[i] instead, so the code still checks every pair. Note that using best_buy in place of prices[i] would not by itself remove the inner loop. A single pass keeping ||the minimum price seen so far and comparing each price against it|| would reach O(n).
complexity.summary: Brute force over all buy/sell day pairs, tracking the maximum difference with the buy day before the sell day. A running minimum is maintained but never actually used in the profit calculation.
